items.name: LYONKA PANTELEEV
items.description: Leonid Pantelkin, known by the nickname Lenka Panteleev, went down in history as the most legendary criminal in Petrograd. His fame is connected with an unprecedented event — on the night of November 11, 1922, he and three accomplices managed to make the first and only successful escape from «KRESTY», considered the most reliable prison in Russia. The irony was that it happened exactly on the fifth anniversary of the creation of the Soviet militia.

items.name: MADUEV SERGEY ALEXANDROVICH
items.description: Sergei Maduev was transferred to the Leningrad «KRESTY», where, confident of the death sentence, he began to actively cooperate with the investigation. He confessed, named accomplices, identified crime scenes, and signed protocols without reading them. He has more than 60 criminal episodes to his credit, including at least ten murders. He tried to escape from prison three times, but all attempts were unsuccessful.

items.name: THE GANG OF YURI PEREPELKIN
items.description: On February 23, 1992, a hostage-taking took place in the pre-trial detention center. Yuri Perepelkin and five fellow inmates demanded weapons, transport and a plane to escape abroad. During the operation, three criminals were eliminated, and one hostage died of his wounds.
